product.title: Bombing
product.description: In Bombing, you take control of a military plane pilot tasked with bombing enemy military lines while carefully avoiding civilian buildings. Inspired by classic Atari 2600 arcade gameplay, every drop of your bomb is a dangerous choice—will you strike the enemy or cause collateral damage?

history.text: Game developed in 3 hours for Trijam #309 (https://itch.io/jam/trijam-309.). Theme: "Dangerous Choices"
The game was developed using C# and Blazor WebAssembly.

features.feature: Bomb military buildings (pink) to earn points.
Avoid hitting civilian buildings—each mistake costs you points.
Destroy all military buildings to advance to the next level.
With every level, your plane gets faster, making precision even more critical.
Game Over if you destroy all civilian buildings or crash into any building.
